name: synapse
description: Synapse — employee-centered workforce capability intelligence. Local-first React + TypeScript app served from 127.0.0.1 by PowerShell 5.1.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck:core && npm run test:unit && npm run build:check

techStackNotes.echarts / @xyflow/react / motion / radix: Listed in TechStack as preferred libraries. Not bundled in this revision: the spider web and galaxy are purpose-built SVG components on d3 (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Add them here when a networked build machine is available; the build script bundles whatever is installed.
techStackNotes.wasm: No Rust/WASM module is shipped. Browser compute runs in a Web Worker (src/workers/scan.worker.ts). docs/ARCHITECTURE.md describes the hook for a future WASM scanner.
